test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which two places are in the news due to the approval of Greenfield airports for better connectivity by the Central Government on 5 May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kota and Puri__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kota, Rajasthan:** This airport is a major step for the city known as an educational and industrial hub, serving the wider Hadoti region and supporting local growth.
 
• **Puri, Odisha:** The airport aims to provide better direct connectivity for the famous pilgrimage site, enhancing access for millions of devotees and tourists.
 
• **Significance: **The approvals fall under the UDAN scheme (Ude Desh Ka Aam Naagrik) and focus on making air travel accessible, stimulating economic activity, and integrating these areas into India's aviation network. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Greenfield Airports **

 
 
• Greenfield airports are developed in locations where no prior airport infrastructure exists.
 
• These projects aim to address the growing demand for air travel and improve regional connectivity.
 
• India has been focusing on constructing Greenfield airports under schemes like UDAN to enhance accessibility to remote areas and boost economic development.
